description: Authorizes production deployments after validating deployment approval, successful verification, rollback readiness, maintenance window, and deployment risk assessment.

unboundSignalReasons.deploymentApproved: Attested by a separate change-management approval step; the Intent carries no approval-status field to bind against.
unboundSignalReasons.changeVerified: Result of an independent pre-deployment verification check; not a value the Intent itself declares.
unboundSignalReasons.rollbackReady: Result of an independent rollback-plan validation; not expressible via the Intent's target/parameters.
unboundSignalReasons.maintenanceWindow: A point-in-time schedule check against the current clock; not a property of the Intent being executed.
unboundSignalReasons.riskScore: A computed deployment-risk score, not a value the caller's Intent declares or could be checked against.

outcome.reason: Production deployment authorized. Deployment approval, change verification, rollback readiness, maintenance window, and risk assessment requirements were satisfied.
Production deployment rejected because the assessed deployment risk exceeds the maximum permitted threshold.
Production deployment rejected because the change has not been successfully verified.
Production deployment rejected because a validated rollback plan is not available.
Production deployment rejected because execution is outside the approved maintenance window.
Production deployment rejected because one or more required policy conditions were not satisfied.
